title: Semio Viz TikZ Library
description: Implement a layered TikZ-based D3-for-LaTeX visualization library (semio-viz) inside print: data, scale, mark, axis, layout, and chart recipe modules covering the exhaustive visualization taxonomy. Library plus tests plus tooling in print only. Coverage gate via print/asset/viz-taxonomy.md and gallery fixtures. Architecture mirrors semio-graph.sty and semio-tree.sty (expl3, l3keys, kind registries, Figure-window integration, token colors).
summary: Fixed Opus review P0/P1s for semio-viz: launch test targets, public API gallery, legend/scale/axis/mark/data defects, and deterministic PDF hashing.
